title: elatine hydropiper var. schkuhriana
intro: Elatine hydropiper var. schkuhriana, commonly known as Schkuhrian Waterwort, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the Elatinaceae family. This plant has been used for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Schkuhrian Waterwort include acting as a diuretic, a vasodilator, and an antispasmodic, making it useful in treating conditions such as urinary tract infections and hypertension. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
